sa_r8-sa100_horse_rider.desc: horse and rider (AS 1743 WS129 modified), 240 x 220 on the sign

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R8-SA100 300 x 675 (DTEI 2010, 1:5), R25, 4 / 12 (edge 4 + border 8). Three symbols stacked, chain 40/175/40/120/40/220/40 = 675: pedestrian 'R8-2 mod' 175 tall in an 80 box (110/80/110) at y 40 — the national R8-2 pedestrian symbol; bicycle 'R8-2 mod' 120 tall, 185 wide (60/185/55) at y 255 — the national R8-2 bicycle symbol; horse and rider 'WS129 mod' 220 tall, 240 wide (30/240/30) at y 415 — traced from this sheet (the AS 1743 WS129 symbol is not in the national set as drawn here). Symbols fitted to the sheet's boxes (aspect kept, centred).
